snippet.title: Global Launch on December 14th丨Silver Palace Gratia Character Trailer - The Foolish and the Brave
snippet.description:
What manner of knight deserves to be praised?
The bunny knight's ears drooped, as she racked her brains for an answer.
Guided by a sage, she ventured forth tentatively, searching step by step.

Until... a piercing shriek rang out above the city, and a storm descended without warning.
With no time to ponder, she spurred her steed skywards and charged forth, sword in hand.
Once again, through her actions and by following her heart, Gratia had found her answer. 

Global launch on DEC 14. Pre-register now: https://urlhe.com/t8fyh
